generation_method: Observed actual raw/events/trials -> shared QA -> baseline/extensions -> grouped CV -> immutable predictions -> validated report, in a strictly verified reference environment. Synthetic software regression only.

tolerance_rationale.discrete_results: Prediction labels and fold accuracies require exact equality. All identity, feature ordering, selected features, split/prediction coverage and true labels require exact equality.
tolerance_rationale.feature_values: rtol=1e-8 and atol=1e-10 bound expected floating-point FFT/filter/Hilbert/power differences; applies to moments of every feature and all epoch values of declared sentinels. Not learned from candidate output.
tolerance_rationale.summary_values: rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-14 allow only aggregation roundoff in mean and sample standard deviation; numeric counts and predictions remain exactly bound by the real evaluation validator.
